newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 969 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 969 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 969 contracts compared with 1,498 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 87 wheat, 409 corn, 459 soybean, 11 soymeal, and three oat, 466 soybean options and two corn options traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 lower to 3-3/4 cents higher, corn was 3/4 to two cents higher and soybeans were two cents lower.
